newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Copenhagen Airport revises July/July cargo data.
newsitem.headline: Copenhagen Airport revises July/July cargo data.

text.p: Denmark's international airport in Copenhagen said on Thursday it handled 310,227 tonnes of cargo in the 12 months ending July 31, 1996, revising a figure it published earlier of 306,050 tonnes.

"The result for the last 12 months was correctly 310,227 tonnes which gives a growth of 13.6 percent compared to the previous 12 months," Copenhagen Airport cargo manager Kim Irmov said in a statement.
Irmov said earlier increased traffic volumes to Asia were behind the result, which was achieved despite a slow start in 1996.
